example.heading: Group by service
example.description: For a sample plumbing campaign, keep emergency repairs and planned installations in separate ad groups. Each group can use its own ad and relevant service page.

example.heading: Review search terms
example.description: Check whether searches match work the business can take. Exclude clearly unrelated terms such as jobs or training when the report shows them.

example.heading: Check the enquiry
example.description: Test the mobile call button and form. Track a completed enquiry separately from a button click so the campaign can be reviewed against meaningful actions.
